exposure: 45 years and older (very advanced maternal age)
number of days needed for cervical priming
very advanced maternal age (45 years and older)
cohort: 1660 women aged 40 years or older at the time of delivery
finding: Women of advanced maternal age (40-44 years) and very advanced maternal age (45 years and older) have a higher chance of unplanned cesarean section, with increasing BMI, no previous vaginal delivery, and increasing days for cervical priming as significant predictors.
mod_finding: Spontaneous start of labor was associated with a lower risk of unplanned cesarean section, while induction of labor was found to be protective against unplanned cesarean section in nulliparous women.
